secrets_of_strixhaven_mystical_archive.notes: 65 distinct cards. Cards 66-130 are Japanese non-foil printings. Cards 131-195 are Japanese silver foil printings.

special_guests.notes: Special Guests are inserted into packs of other sets rather than having their own boosters.

bloomburrow.notes: Pack-in basic lands are full art (269-281). Normal basic lands (369-378) appear within the special editions block.
